biography:
Shane has 20+ years of successful experience sourcing, developing and managing clients for the data center co-location and hyperscale industries.  He is passionate about working with CyrusOne's largest strategic clients at every level within the organization helping them create a flexible solution that meets their specific needs.

He understands the options and complexities that are involved with the decision making process of an organization's data center strategy and will assist companies throughout the data center life-cycle.  His areas of specialty include:
- data center strategy & planning
- assessments
- problem resolution
- cloud peering
- consolidations
- migration planning & relocation
- business continuance
- turn-key design/build services

His primary goal is to provide every customer with the most predictable, reliable, flexible, and efficient data center solution.
